findings: scripts/containers/tests/test_envelope.sh line 333 prints `3.24788e+10: syntax error: invalid arithmetic operator` in IMG-KCOV and still exits 0 (the awk of the image prints a large number in exponent form and the shell arithmetic rejects it): the test swallows an instrument error (evidence wp23/bashcov/envelope-test-alone-kcov.txt). Owner: WP-11 (scripts/containers tests).

tests/test_build_system.sh is not hermetic: it runs `git commit` in a temp project and fails with exit 128 (`Author identity unknown`) in IMG-KCOV, where no git identity is configured (measured: the first re-baseline attempt, 0 of 593 executed for exactly that reason). The harness command supplies GIT_AUTHOR_* and GIT_COMMITTER_* variables; the test should set its own identity. Owner: the Build framework tests (not WP-23).

the tracer's line for a continued simple command depends on the bash version (5.3.9 on the host reports its first line, 5.2.15 in IMG-KCOV its last): measured by the container run of test_bash_coverage.sh; bashcov.py now folds either onto the command's counted line (review round 1 of WP-23).
honest_reading: Re-measured after the WF11 review (B2). tests/test_build_system.sh (tracked, 40 tests, 40 passed in each of the three runs) copies Build/ into a temp project and sources all four Build/lib libraries, so the earlier 0 of 597 (0.17 percent) was an artefact of the WRONG harness command (test_check_exclusions.sh cannot reach Build/lib) and a claim ('no test executes them') that was never measured against tests/. The figure is the line coverage of the four Build/lib scripts by THAT suite: 168 of 593 executable lines = 28.33 percent, identical in three runs (same executed and uncovered line sets, bash 5.2.15(1)-release). It is a minimum on a proxy (line, not branch; 11.4.224 C); orchestrator.sh is 3.89 percent: the suite sources it but runs almost none of its functions. It is still NOT the figure of all build and bash scripts: widening it needs the scripts other work packages are editing now (scripts/containers, scripts/longops, scripts/build, scripts/repo).
instrument: ps4-line-trace (scripts/bash-coverage.sh, full-path PS4, path-aware attribution) in IMG-KCOV through TIC build-scripts unit, bash 5.2.15(1)-release
limits: line, not branch: an if/else line counts covered when either side ran (the measured founding case of 11.4.224 C)
regions under `set +x`, commands run by `sh` (dash) or a process that unsets BASH_ENV, and traps are not traced and count as uncovered
the executable-line rule is a heuristic: structural lines, function definitions, here-document bodies and continuation lines are not counted (bashcov.py docstring)
a coverage percentage is a minimum on a proxy, necessary and never sufficient (11.4.224 C): it does not show that a test would catch a defect

scope.command: bash tests/test_build_system.sh (with GIT_AUTHOR_/GIT_COMMITTER_ identity variables: the suite runs git commit in a temp project)
